transcript.text: dryer drum wont turn but i can here it running, hotpiont. clothes just sit there

If the motor is running but the drum isn't turning, the drive belt has likely slipped off or snapped. This is very common on Hotpoint dryers and means the motor spins but doesn't transfer power to the drum. To confirm this, please unplug the dryer first, then try turning the drum by hand. If it spins completely freely with no resistance (like a wheel on an axle), the belt is probably off or broken. If it feels stiff or hard to turn, something might be jammed inside.
just tried it unplugged and the drum spins really easy almost no resistance at all

That suggests the drive belt has probably snapped or slipped completely off its pulleys, which is why the motor runs but the drum stays still. To be sure, please unplug the dryer again and remove the four screws at the back of the top panel; lift the lid from the front so it rests on the back casing. Look inside to see if the black rubber belt is present around the large drum pulley or if it has broken or slipped off. If you can't see it or it's broken, that is your faulty part.
ok will take the top off now, i can also see a black rubbery strip at the bottom when i shine a torch through the filter slot

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
That prefix is enough to identify the series, but because the full number is rubbed off I cannot guarantee part compatibility for your specific unit. Since this repair involves removing the main cabinet to access the drum and tensioner mechanism, I recommend contacting an engineer or using the manufacturer's official spares service with your partial model number to ensure you get the correct belt for your exact configuration.
